description: Defines structures, constants, and types for disk cache block file format, including header info, sparse data support, and file management details.

classes.name: BlockFileHeader
classes.description: Header structure for block files, containing metadata such as magic number, version, file indices, entry counts, and allocation map.

classes.name: SparseHeader
classes.description: Control structure for sparse data entries, including signature, magic, key length, last block info, and dummy padding.

classes.name: SparseData
classes.description: Contains SparseHeader and a bitmap for tracking used or known child blocks in sparse data management.
